High-level wrapper around ImpellerContext. Contexts are expensive, thread-safe (except OpenGL: bound to the creating thread), share one per application lifetime.

Software rendering: use the OpenGL backend with Mesa/llvmpipe (or the system GL on macOS). Create a hidden GLFW window, make its GL context current, then wrap an FBO as a surface. No Metal/Vulkan device needed, which makes this path ideal for headless tests and most examples.

Creates an OpenGL(ES) context. glProcAddress resolves GL symbols (e.g. eglGetProcAddress or glfwGetProcAddress). Must be called on the thread that owns the GL context.

    ...raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Convenience: creates an OpenGL ES context using GLFW as the GL proc-address loader. A current GLFW GL context must exist on this thread (visible or hidden window). Works with software GL (llvmpipe) for headless rendering.
